parameters.prompt: =You are a conversion-focused cold email copywriter for Omladinska zadruga Avala. CONTEXT: Omladinska zadruga Avala connects Serbian companies (especially construction and engineering firms) with qualified young workers aged 18-30. Owner: Miloš Mitić. Core client pain: Can't find reliable workers, high turnover (40%+ annually), young workers lack experience. Our solution: Pre-screened candidate pool, training, mentorship, 48h replacement guarantee. LEAD DATA: Name: {{ $('Split People').item.json.first_name }}, Role: {{ $('Split People').item.json.title }}, Company: {{ $('Split Companies').item.json.name }}, Industry: {{ $('Split Companies').item.json.industry }}, Company size: {{ $('Split Companies').item.json.estimated_num_employees }} employees, Location: {{ $('Split People').item.json.city }}, {{ $('Split People').item.json.state }}, LinkedIn bio: {{ $json.about || 'N/A' }}. YOUR TASK: Write a cold email in Serbian (latinica) that immediately grabs attention using problem-agitation-solution framework. Must be hyper-personalized for their specific company and industry. Return only JSON format: {"subject": "[max 50 chars]", "body": "[100-150 words]"}.  SUBJECT LINE PSYCHOLOGY: Use pattern interrupt + specificity. Formulas that work: (1) "{{ $('Split Companies').item.json.name }}: [specific metric/result]", (2) "{{ $('Split People').item.json.first_name }}, [counterintuitive insight]?", (3) "[Industry] firma: kako [benefit] za [timeframe]". Avoid: Generic greetings, questions marks, exclamations, RE:/FWD: tricks. Examples: "{{ $('Split Companies').item.json.name }}: 48h do novog radnika", "{{ $('Split People').item.json.first_name }}, Gen Z radnici nisu problem", "Građevinske firme: fluktuacija sa 40% na 8%". BODY COPY STRUCTURE: [HOOK - Observation] Start with specific detail about their company from data provided. Make it personal, not generic. [PROBLEM - Agitate] Name their #1 pain quantified. Construction firms lose 3-4 weeks per year finding replacements. That's 8% of revenue eaten by recruitment chaos. [INSIGHT - Pattern Interrupt] Challenge common belief. "Problem nisu mladi. Problem je što ih niko ne priprema za posao." [SOLUTION - Specific Benefits] Omladinska zadruga Avala offers: (1) Pre-screened pool of 200+ young workers with basic training, (2) 48-hour replacement if someone quits, (3) Mentor program that cuts onboarding time 60%. [PROOF - Micro Social Proof] "15+ građevinskih firmi u Beogradu. Prosečna firma uštedi 12 dana godišnje na regrutaciji." [CTA - Low Friction] Don't ask for meeting. Offer value-first or use assumptive close. "Mogu li da vam pošaljem listu dostupnih kandidata za {{ $('Split Companies').item.json.name }}?" or "Interesuje vas kako ovo funkcioniše u praksi?" Sign-off: Srdačno, Miloš Mitić, Omladinska zadruga Avala, milos@ozavala.rs. ADVANCED PSYCHOLOGY PRINCIPLES: Use loss aversion ("koliko vas košta kad radnik ode nakon 2 nedelje?"), specificity over vagueness ("3 dana" not "brzo"), customer language not company jargon ("ne mogu da nađem ljude" not "optimizovati talent acquisition"), contrast principle (before/after scenarios), micro-commitments (small ask first), objection pre-emption (address "previše mladi" concern proactively). WRITING RULES: Active voice only. One idea per sentence. No buzzwords: streamline, optimize, innovative, synergy, leverage. No exclamation points. No ALL CAPS. Conversational but professional tone. Short paragraphs (2-3 sentences max). White space for scannability. End with question to demand response. QUALITY CHECKLIST: (1) Subject line feels personal not mass-sent? (2) First sentence references specific company detail? (3) Problem quantified with number? (4) Solution shows outcomes not features? (5) CTA is low-friction and specific? parameters.content:
# Cold Email Outreach (PRIMARY DRIVER)

## Flow:
1. Search companies (Apollo) - 20 per run
2. Find decision makers - 3 per company
3. Check for duplicates in Supabase
4. Enrich profiles (optional, LinkFinder)
5. Generate personalized email (Gemini)
6. Save to kontakti table
7. Send via Instantly.ai
8. Mark as sent with timestamp

## Volume:
- Runs every 3 hours (Mon-Fri)
- 5 runs/day
- 20 companies × 3 people = 60 leads/run
- After duplicate filter: ~20-30 new/run
- Daily: 100-150 emails
- Weekly: 500-750 emails
- Monthly: 2,000-3,000 emails

## Instantly.ai Setup:
- Campaign: "OZ Avala Construction Outreach"
- Sending domains: 2-3 (rotate)
- Warmup: ON (critical for deliverability)
- Daily limit: 50-100/domain
- Follow-up sequence: 2-3 emails (if no response)

## Integration with Email Master v5:
- Positive reply → Update status to 'Zainteresovan'
- Instantly webhook detects reply → Triggers Email Master
- Email Master handles meeting booking sequence

## Lead Quality:
All leads have:
✓ Verified/guessed email
✓ Decision maker role
✓ Company 10-1000 employees
✓ Serbia location
✓ Relevant industry
